judges.a: JUDGE A — sceptical power user (strongest tier, adversarial)

ranking_rule: user_value * (feasibility/5) / days; ties (<0.1) broken by lifecycle then moat_fit; days = backlog estimate unless Judge A verified a smaller residual at HEAD

rows.title: Witnessed by default
rows.reason: Already landed at HEAD: correctness_gate.apply_witnesses runs on GET /fundamentals (routers/fundamentals.py:137) and EquityOverviewPanel renders the disagreement and witness figure in the cell tooltip. Nothing left to build but tooltip-to-inline polish.
rows.synthesis_rationale: Verified at HEAD: routers/fundamentals.py:137 runs correctness_gate.apply_witnesses on GET /fundamentals and the overview cell carries the disagreement. Nothing S-sized remains. Dead.

rows.title: A disclosure feed you can build on
rows.reason: Mostly landed (180-day paged window, AttachHis, per-lane AnnouncementWindow); the residual is serving the private _kind plus dual timestamps, a one-day wire change with nothing to screenshot.

rows.title: Reasons about you: your position and your notes in every answer
rows.resized_reason: read_notes and the snapshot holdings already exist at HEAD; residual is a preamble line and a brief card
rows.reason: read_notes already exists and the agent can call get_portfolio; the residual is a preamble position line and a brief metric, which saves one tool call rather than an hour.

rows.title: The Watch: wake sweep and a 'while you were away' card that states its blind spots
rows.reason: A sleeping laptop sweeps only on wake, when the user is already looking; classifier rot and small-cap boilerplate make it a babysit item at twice the S budget.

rows.title: Number firewall with a rupee scale witness
rows.reason: False orphans on legitimate multi-step arithmetic teach users to ignore the strike within a week; tolerance tuning is open-ended and M-sized.

rows.title: Page receipts
rows.reason: Scanned small-cap filings have no text layer, so the receipt reads 'scanned, from the aggregator' on exactly the names this product targets; S-M, not S.

rows.title: Coverage honesty: say what the app could not see
rows.reason: It changes no number; a user who sees 'Statements: unavailable' every day on SME names learns to ignore the strip. StatusChrome already reads provider-health, so only the brief block and strip are new.

rows.title: Start recording: point-in-time EOD and fundamentals observations
rows.reason: Nothing visible for months; a laptop closed for a week walks the archive on wake from the user's IP, and one bhavcopy format change writes silent gaps unless the marker is perfect.

rows.title: Tripwires: kill criteria compiled once, watched for free
rows.reason: No sweep exists (BL-04 unbuilt), so armed rules are checked only when the app opens, which is when the user would look anyway; the field vocabulary becomes a contract to maintain.

rows.title: Red Pen: paste anyone's numbers, get a marked-up verdict
rows.reason: Most tips are narrative, not numbers; the checker says CANNOT CHECK on the tips that matter, and the BL-05 grammar it needs does not exist (company_narrative._NUMBER_RE reads $ and K/M/B/T only).

rows.title: Proof Open: the first minute is a demonstration
rows.reason: Marketing shaped as onboarding: the same disagreement already rides the overview tooltip, so the serious investor gains nothing after minute one; an all-agree large cap makes it look empty.

rows.title: Turn receipt
rows.reason: Core already at HEAD: the composer ContextMeter and the per-message tokens/$ footer (R15-AGENT-040, ChatSidebar.tsx:1402/1543, chat-history.ts usage/spendUsd) expose cost and forgetting; the residual tools/sources/checks line is line creep.
rows.synthesis_rationale: Judge verified the ContextMeter and per-message tokens/$ footer at HEAD; the residual tools/sources/checks line duplicates the transcript and the sources tray. Dead.

rows.title: Cap-table X-ray: names, beneficial owners, encumbrance, holder counts, pledge trend
rows.reason: PAN is not disclosed so 'same name string' is all it can say; the BSE-only XBRL lane leaves NSE-only SME names, the target, with today's summary. M, not S.

rows.title: Corporate-action chain
rows.reason: The parser it promised already landed (CorporateAction kind/ratio/ex_date across NSE+BSE, R15-DATA-025); what remains is chart markers, factor receipts and a toggle, and a wrongly applied factor rewrites price history.

rows.title: Results-day first take (deterministic results-grid extraction)
rows.resized_reason: the exchange_financials reframe (filed revenue/PAT/EPS with URL and filing date already at HEAD), not the PDF grid
rows.reason: As written (PDF grid, archetype dictionary, page receipts) it is M with four unmet deps; only the reframe onto exchange_financials (filed revenue/PAT/EPS with XBRL URL and filing date already at HEAD) is S, and it loses per-cell page receipts.

rows.title: Guidance ledger: what management said against what printed
rows.reason: Most target small caps hold no calls; where they do, hedged language makes HIT/MISS a judgement the verbatim gate cannot make, and every transcript costs BYOK tokens. M-L.

rows.title: Tip Ledger
rows.reason: The serious investor this product targets does not trade Telegram tips; a wrong resolve on a renamed SME ticker yields a confident, libel-shaped scorecard. M, writes the book.

rows.title: Brief diff: ask again, see what changed
rows.reason: Price-derived metrics change daily so the strip is never empty; re-research is rare enough that the prior is weeks stale and 'everything changed'. Lead with filing facts or it is the wall it replaces.

rows.title: Undo and ghost edits
rows.reason: Undo-from-review with a pre-image already exists (proposed-changes.ts undo, status 'undone') and AUTO no longer touches data-writes; Cmd-Z and ghost rows are polish any app has.

rows.title: Trust bench and 'Audit me'
rows.reason: Truth packs rot within a quarter and the page hands rivals copy; the user gains nothing beyond the witness flags the overview already shows. An agent-day per release of upkeep.

rows.title: The Figure and the Why key
rows.reason: A lineage card is a tooltip with more rows; the witness verdicts it would render already ride the cell tooltip, and every metric must declare lineage forever.

rows.title: Evidence locker
rows.reason: Storing pypdf's extraction of a scanned PDF preserves garbage faithfully; 'changed under you' fires on pypdf drift unless bytes are hashed. Depends on unbuilt BL-06.

rows.title: Gatekeeper exits
rows.reason: The notify half needs the unbuilt Watch; only an on-open timeline card with the 180-day cluster rule over the now-paged feed stands alone, and SUBCATNAME drift needs a visible unclassified bucket.

rows.title: Exit Door: can I actually get out
rows.reason: BhavRow has no delivery column; a total-volume version overstates exit capacity 2-3x on operator names, reassuring exactly when it should not. The honest version needs the recorder and the delivery fallback.

rows.title: Filing clock
rows.reason: FiledPeriod.filed and quarter end already give the days-to-results series, but five periods is not a trend; 'results 44 days after quarter end' is noise the user cannot act on for quarters.

rows.title: Living model
rows.reason: A worse Excel: the user who keeps a model already has Excel; actuals auto-fill only for names with parseable filings and the xlsx writer is a new sidecar dependency.

rows.title: Rulebook: it holds you to your own words
rows.reason: It annotates, never blocks, for the disciplined minority who already keep their rules; a mis-compiled rule nags on every add. Depends on unbuilt BL-24.

rows.title: Red-flag rule packs
rows.reason: 'Steps matched' sequences also describe honest turnarounds; the operator reviewing every rule of every pack is babysitting by design. Three unbuilt dependencies.

rows.title: Track record: the app keeps score on itself and its providers
rows.reason: Value accrues only from repeated briefs on the same symbol; most users never re-brief a name enough to grade anything, and no claims ledger or migration story exists in the sidecar today.

rows.title: The number changed: drift ledger
rows.reason: Nothing to say for weeks (no recorder exists), then false alarms on TTM rolls get it muted the week it starts talking.

rows.title: Seven Pages: annual-report reader
rows.reason: Micro-cap annual reports are often scans; it reads '3 of your 7 pages' on the names it exists for, each run costs real BYOK tokens, and the AR locator endpoint is unverified.

rows.title: Alerts with a track record
rows.reason: Alerts are what every dashboard has; the dry-run over a 180-day tape is shallow enough to be false comfort, and the tripwire engine it rides does not exist.

rows.title: Operator radar
rows.reason: Hand-tuned thresholds with no recorded history false-positive on every genuine re-rating; a nervous user sells winners. ASM/GSM and BSE delivery lanes are unconfirmed.

rows.title: Honesty card and trial ledger for backtests
rows.reason: Backtesting is peripheral to the witnessed-research user and it sits on an admitted critical metrics defect (COD-backtest-1); honest deflation of a number the target user never computes.

rows.title: Priced in: what the market cap already assumes
rows.reason: Its history column reads the vendor statements that serve another company on SME ticker collisions (DAT-P3-1 family still open, the -SM.NS gate in flight); a sensitivity grid on witnessed TTM alone is the only honest v1.

rows.title: Forkable research (.vybrief) and the receipt bundle
rows.reason: A file format is a forever promise for a feature retail users do not use; as a diagnostics bundle it is a zip nobody has asked for yet. Depends on unbuilt BL-05 and BL-22.

rows.title: Calm protocol
rows.reason: Fires only while the app is open during market hours, when the sleeping-laptop user is not there; 'looks like the market' minutes before a filing lands is exactly wrong.

rows.title: Instant cockpit
rows.reason: A boot-speed cache any desktop app has; the win sits in the defect fixes (the port wait now runs on thread::spawn in lib.rs), and a mirror risks a cached price reading as live during market hours. Not demoable in a screenshot.
rows.synthesis_rationale: Boot speed cannot be shown in a populated screenshot or a transcript, and a two-writer price mirror is a live-vs-cached drift surface during market hours. Dead.

rows.title: Earned autonomy
rows.reason: The whitelist that carried the value already landed (AUTO_APPLIED_KINDS = panel/chart/watchlist; data-writes never auto-apply). The residual tally nudges the user toward less oversight, which the row itself names as its risk.
rows.synthesis_rationale: AUTO_APPLIED_KINDS already excludes data-writes at HEAD; the residual tally argues for less oversight, which the row itself names as its risk. Dead.

rows.title: GO bar and learned routines
rows.reason: Bloomberg mnemonics in a product whose spine is the composer; the palette already fuzzy-matches a symbol and 'shareholding' in two keystrokes, and the routine-learning half nags.

rows.title: Page One
rows.reason: Three boxes of items that do not exist yet (BL-18, BL-35, BL-15); the filler scorer punishes the qualitative context small-cap research lives on.

rows.title: Pre-print card and your forecast record
rows.reason: Asking the user for three numbers the evening before is homework most will skip, and n<4 quarters shows nothing for a year; three unbuilt dependencies.

rows.title: One number, one truth
rows.reason: Covers only what <Fig> has adopted, which is nothing today; timing skew between panels fires more often than a real disagreement.

rows.title: Surprise without analysts (SUE)
rows.reason: A seasonal random walk on eight lumpy small-cap quarters gives a sigma with n=4 effective; surprise against an expectation nobody held. The vendor second source is the collision lane.

rows.title: Proceeds ledger
rows.reason: Issues below the monitoring-agency threshold, most micro-caps, have no MAR to parse; PDF table parsing is never four days once scans and merged cells appear.

rows.title: Cheap-paper calendar
rows.reason: LLM extraction of per-tranche lock-ins from a scanned allotment letter degrades to 'enter manually', after which the calendar holds what the user typed. Two unbuilt dependencies.

rows.title: Peer set and read-across
rows.reason: A comps table is on every site; the read-across half needs typed edges the user curates by hand and reviews yearly, which is babysitting.

rows.title: Dodge ledger and who's in the room
rows.reason: Small-cap transcript coverage is thin; a deterministic DEFLECTED label on a legitimate no-guidance answer is an accusation with a rule attached.

rows.title: User-addable MCP servers
rows.reason: Its surviving motivating examples are screener.in scrapers the ledger says not to add; it opens a prompt-injection path (WLD-harness-context-4 still open) for a feature with no honest data source behind it.
rows.synthesis_rationale: Boundary: its surviving examples are scrapers of a source the ledger says not to add, so no keyless honest data source; it opens an injection path while WLD-harness-context-4 is open. The plugin system stays; this is not it. Dead.

rows.title: Factor X-ray
rows.reason: Factor-exposure strips are standard portfolio-tool fare; its ranks launder the still-open statement-lane collisions (DAT-P3-1 family) into confident percentiles, and the momentum/volatility legs need months of recorded EOD that do not exist.
rows.synthesis_rationale: Percentiles over the still-open statement-lane collisions (DAT-P3-1 family) are confident wrong percentiles; momentum and volatility legs need recorded months that do not exist. Dead.

rows.title: Incubator: frozen rules with an out-of-sample record
rows.reason: Months of wall-clock before an out-of-sample record means anything, for a systematic seat that is not the product's user; the recorder it needs does not exist.

rows.title: As-of screens
rows.reason: There is no recorded history to run a screen 'as of'; it is a chip on an empty table for months.

rows.title: Between the prints
rows.reason: An hour a month of per-filer spec curation is the definition of babysitting, and most small caps file nothing between prints. Three unbuilt dependencies.

rows.title: Annual-report redline
rows.reason: Fused table cells and scanned ARs produce garbage hunks that look like findings; the side-by-side is only as good as pypdf on a micro-cap PDF. Two unbuilt dependencies.

rows.title: Accounts linter with reasoned suppressions
rows.reason: Depends on the blocked statement lane (WLD-T-4, DAT-P3-1/P4-1/P5-1/P6-1 admitted critical, still open) and on the unbuilt BL-09 engine; it reports no-data on exactly the names it exists for.
rows.synthesis_rationale: Rides the blocked statement lane and the unbuilt BL-09 engine; reports no-data on the SME names it exists for. Dead.

rows.title: Personas on probation
rows.reason: Gives the user nothing usable for months (n<10 refuses to score), carries 'predictions in a finance app' optics, and grades persona cosplay that is not the serious investor's workflow; BL-41's falsifier captures the discipline.
rows.synthesis_rationale: Refuses to score below n=10, so nothing usable for months; persona cosplay is not the serious investor's workflow and the falsifier in BL-41 keeps the discipline. Dead.

rows.title: Rule forge: event studies from any predictive sentence
rows.reason: L band (14 days) on an unprobed cross-sectional announcement archive that does not exist; with the per-symbol fetcher it is an anecdote detector for months. Depends on unbuilt BL-08 and BL-34.
rows.synthesis_rationale: L band (14 days) on a cross-sectional announcement archive the app does not have; breaches the S-band rule outright and depends on the unbuilt recorder. Dead.

rows.title: 'I noticed you bought'
rows.reason: The watching half that made it interesting was struck with trading; what survives is a 'why did you buy' journal prompt any notes app provides, and it still needs the open COD-host-actions-proposed-changes-2 fix.
rows.synthesis_rationale: Boundary: the watching half was struck with trading; what survives is a journal prompt any notes app has, still gated on an open proposed-changes fix. Dead.

rows.id: Candidate: Filing watcher (System 1 triage in front of the BYOK model)
rows.title: Filing watcher (System 1 triage in front of the BYOK model)
rows.reason: Its own MEASURE pass says the zero-shot checkpoint loses to the sidecar's existing $0 regex on composer_intent and ties majority on holding_relevance; the path forward is a fine-tune (a funded model lane) plus a new local inference runtime with no Windows/CUDA route, breaching the no-new-heavy-dependency and keyless-default boundaries. Unsized, no code, no UI.
rows.synthesis_rationale: Boundary: its own MEASURE pass loses to the sidecar's $0 regex; the path forward is a fine-tune (a funded model lane) and a new local inference runtime with no Windows/CUDA route (a heavy dependency). The receipts-per-item idea lives on in BL-04/BL-23. Dead.
